name: Busuu Premium
tagline: Build a personal language practice system with user-authored lessons and review

pricing.notes: Typical monthly Premium price; annual billing is lower.

verdictSummary: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Busuu Premium, build a personal language practice system with user-authored lessons and review. The hard boundary is curriculum, community corrections, speech tools, certification, and mobile apps, plus content, pedagogy, and network.
coreLoopDIY: Turn user-authored language lessons into a study plan, schedule retrieval practice and review, and show progress without claiming accredited instruction.
requirements: optional speech or language-model API key
whatYouLose: curriculum, community corrections, speech tools, certification, and mobile apps
ongoingBurden: curriculum quality, assessment validity, content rights, spaced-repetition tuning, speech models, sync, moderation, and support
whyPeopleStillPay: People still pay for Busuu Premium because the learning loop is buildable, while trusted curriculum, instructors, feedback, credentials, and community are not. The recurring cost buys curriculum quality, assessment validity, content rights, spaced-repetition tuning, speech models, sync, moderation, and support, not just the visible interface.

priorArt.name: Moodle
priorArt.desc: Long-running open-source learning platform with courses, assessments, and progress tracking.

alternatives.name: Anki
alternatives.desc: A durable personal language system for authored material, audio prompts and scheduled review; community correction is not included.

facts.install: Use the Windows installer, macOS DMG or official Linux launcher
facts.dataFormat: Local profile files including collection.anki2, collection.media and backups; exports use .apkg/.colpkg, with optional AnkiWeb sync
facts.gapVsPaid: Anki lacks Busuu's structured course and native-speaker correction community, leaving content and feedback to the learner.

alternatives.name: AnkiDroid
alternatives.desc: Android spaced repetition for your own vocabulary, recordings and lessons, without Busuu's social layer.

facts.install: Install from Google Play or F-Droid, or sideload the official APK
facts.dataFormat: An Anki collection and media on the Android device, with .apkg import/export and optional AnkiWeb sync
facts.gapVsPaid: AnkiDroid lacks Busuu's structured course and native-speaker correction community, leaving content and feedback to the learner.

alternatives.name: Moodle
alternatives.desc: Author lessons, quizzes and review schedules for yourself or a small class; operating Moodle is the new homework.

facts.install: Upload the PHP release to a web server, create a database and moodledata directory, then complete the browser installer
facts.dataFormat: Courses, users, grades and settings in SQL; uploaded files in the separate moodledata directory
facts.gapVsPaid: Moodle has no native-speaker correction community or expert language path, and operating it becomes additional homework.
facts.setupBlocker: PHP and database requirements, protected writable storage, cron, SMTP, backups and upgrades are all the operator's responsibility

notes: Editorial comparison targets the Premium plan and a personal study companion DIY substitute. Recheck price before merge.
prompt:
Build a closest honest personal substitute for Busuu Premium in an empty repository.
Use Next.js 15, TypeScript, SQLite, Drizzle ORM, and a service worker for offline use; do not offer alternative stacks.
The core loop is: turn user-authored language lessons into a study plan, schedule retrieval practice and review, and show progress without claiming accredited instruction.
Make the first run work locally with one documented command.
Store all user data locally by default and make export straightforward.
Put secrets in .env, ship .env.example, and never commit credentials.
Import Markdown, text, or user-authored notes and split them into editable learning units.
Create flashcards and short quizzes only after showing the generated items for approval.
Implement a transparent spaced-repetition schedule with due, again, hard, good, and easy actions.
Add goals, study sessions, streak-free progress charts, notes, and weak-topic review.
For language practice, record the learner and compare timing or pronunciation without presenting medical claims.
Support offline use, full export, reset, backup, and deletion of all learning data.
Include clear empty, loading, success, and recoverable error states.
Add input validation, safe filenames, and graceful handling of unavailable APIs.
Write focused tests for the core transformation and one end-to-end happy path.
Create a README with setup, architecture, permissions, data location, and backup steps.
Do not add accounts, billing, telemetry, analytics, or a hosted control plane.
Do not claim to reproduce proprietary data, network liquidity, regulated access, or frontier infrastructure.
Deliberately leave out licensed premium courses.
Deliberately leave out accredited certificates and grading.
Deliberately leave out live tutors, large classrooms, and a learner marketplace.
Finish by running the tests and listing the exact commands used.
